Starship evolution: From Starhopper’s 150m hop in 2019 to Starship V3 completing Flight 12 🚀🔥

From humble tethered hops… to SN prototypes landing softly… to full-stack catches, orbital flights, hot staging and successful payload deployments.

In just a few years, SpaceX has transformed Starship from a steel prototype in Texas into the foundation for a multiplanetary future.

And this is still only the beginning.

From Starbase to the Indian Ocean 

Starship Flight 12 just delivered a masterclass in spaceflight engineering.  

Hot-staging separation, powerful booster boostback burn, mock Starlink deployment, blistering atmospheric re-entry, and a pinpoint soft splashdown in the Indian Ocean.  

Version 3 is already looking strong.

SpaceX cooking again

Video

Perfect flip, landing burn on 2 engines, and a pinpoint soft splashdown next to a Starlink buoy in the Indian Ocean.

Big step for reusability. Mars is coming!
